subText: Full-Stack Developer | Computer Science @ Mauá | Founder at NovaRutra Informática
heroTitle: Unleashing powerful solutions with precision and mastery.
aboutText: I'm a senior-year Computer Science student at Instituto Mauá de Tecnologia (São Caetano do Sul, Brazil) and founder of NovaRutra Informática, my own IT services company for desktops and servers. Before running the company I worked as a Java intern on legacy systems (JBoss, WildFly, JSF, AWS) and I still build software as a freelancer — mostly as a frontend/full-stack engineer. Native Portuguese, fluent English, currently learning French. I've led Nawat Games, contributed to the Dev Community club, and had my solo game voted best in the org.
exp1Description: Founded and run my own IT services company, specializing in hardware support for desktops and servers. I do absolutely everything: sales, dispatch, diagnostics, maintenance, network setup and infrastructure consulting for local clients.
exp2Description: Developed and maintained legacy Java 6/8 systems on JBoss, WildFly and JSF (Java on the frontend). Worked with AWS deployment pipelines and Docker containers in production, focused on stability and observability of mission-critical systems.
exp3Company: Instituto Mauá de Tecnologia — São Caetano do Sul
exp3Description: Final year of the Computer Science program. Focus on software engineering, distributed systems, algorithms and AI. Strong track record with Java, Python, C and Clojure, plus solid foundations in discrete math and data structures.
exp4Description: As a freshman Computer Science student, I placed 2nd competing against third-year Computer Engineering seniors. An early validation of my algorithmic foundations and game-AI instincts.
exp5Description: Promoted to lead the Nawat Games game jam. My solo game The Zen of Car was voted the best trainee game of the org. I presented the project at IMT's Hands On event and gave a talk on game development to incoming freshmen.
exp6Description: I contributed as a programmer to IMT's software org, building products for students, faculty and external clients. I also ran an open React class for fellow Mauá students (Aulão_React repo).
projectsSubtitle: The work that best represents my forge as a developer — from legacy backends to international frontends.
project1Description: My best project: a platform to manage and monitor Instituto Mauá's international courses, built in partnership with Fontys University of Applied Sciences in the Netherlands. I worked on the frontend with focus on UX, multi-stakeholder backend integration and flows designed for students and teachers across two countries.
project2Subtitle: App with facial and document recognition
project2Description: Application built for São Paulo's Metro using AI for facial and document recognition to speed up pass validation. I worked on both the React Native frontend and the backend, which processes images and validates identity in real time.
project3Description: Health management system built as an integrative project. I worked on the frontend, shaping the experience for healthcare professionals who consult and update clinical records in a controlled environment.
project4Description: Web platform built in partnership with a cultural NGO. Frontend-first integrative project focused on accessibility, visual identity and content tailored to the community the organization serves.
project5Description: Solo indie game made with Unity and voted the best trainee game at Nawat Games. I handled design, mechanics, code and polish by myself — which earned me the promotion to lead the org's game jam the following year.
project6Description: React starter with Clean Architecture + TypeScript + SWC + Vite + TailwindCSS + Jest + Husky + Prettier. Built to bootstrap new projects quickly and document the engineering practices I rely on day-to-day.
